adapted_implementations.changes: Removed case interface defaults; parameterized export; retained finite operator support with explicit failure.
Removed project model/image paths and case CLI; retained TensorFlow-free numerical segment execution.
Removed model/cut defaults; supported existing BiasAdd and bias-free convolutions; pinned unsafe self-coupled groups; added bounded wrapper and numerical checks.
Kept the BN/BiasAdd/Identity folding and im2col convolution; added GroupNorm/attention fusion and a generic CLI without project paths.
Parameterized graph/features paths; kept three-way logits and timing comparison.
Removed project defaults; kept BLAS probe and per-block/per-op timing.
Generalized model dir and stage list; kept all-PS summary schema.

scope: Reusable workflows and checked host helpers. Model-specific native evaluation, target compilation, independent-set acceptance and hardware validation remain task-specific.
